> **Example file, read-only.** Invented leader, invented company. The leader's own files live in the workspace root, not in this folder.

# example/ — A Filled-In Workspace

This folder holds six workspace files (`about-me.md`, `my-work.md`, `tomorrow.md`, `commitments.md`, `decisions.md`, `connections.md`), plus one morning brief, one person file, and one meeting note, filled in for a leader who does not exist.

The leader is Nadia Brozek, Chief Operating Officer at Larkfield Systems, a 118-person software company in Guelph, Ontario. Each of those six is the same file that ships empty in the workspace root, with real answers in place of the brackets.

The template notes are stripped from these copies. What is left is only what a leader would actually write.

Read it to see what a good answer looks like. The files are cross-wired on purpose: the person in `commitments.md` appears in `my-work.md`, the meeting in `tomorrow.md` shows up in the brief, and the CRM row, marked `missing` and `Dismissed` in `connections.md`, is why the brief ends on `(not connected)` and still asks for nothing.

The brief runs 325 words against the 400-word cap in `morning-brief`. The Fathom line is a fault rather than a nudge, so it renders even though the CRM gap on the last line does not, and it does not count against the cap.

Two of these files are here because a leader has no mental model for them. `people/denise-okafor.md` shows how far a person file goes and where it stops. `meetings/2026-03-09-fairloch-escalation/notes.md` is the meeting that four other files point at, and it is the reason one line in `commitments.md` and one entry in `decisions.md` both read `To verify`. There is no `transcript.md` beside it, because Fathom was `failing`.

Other paths cited in these files, such as `meetings/2026-03-12-fairloch-options/notes.md` and `people/devin-osei.md`, show what a real source reference looks like. Those files are not reproduced here.

Nothing in this folder is read by any behaviour. It is reference. Fill in the copies in the workspace root instead, and leave this one alone.
